about.title: About Lake County Outdoors
about.text: At Lake County Outdoors, we built our name by showing up and doing the work right. For over 10 years, we’ve helped Twin Cities property owners improve and protect their spaces with expert landscaping, hardscaping, tree work, and a strong focus on commercial snow removal and ice management. We take pride in reliable service, clear communication, and results that last through every Minnesota season.
about.imageAlt: The Lake County Outdoors crew in safety vests standing behind a snow pusher at night

items.title: Our Experience
paragraphs: At Lake County Outdoors, LLC, we specialize in landscaping, excavation, and snow removal. With over 10 years of combined experience, we are a trusted leader in all things outdoor transformation and maintenance.
We service a wide range of properties, from residential lots to expansive malls and Fortune 100 corporate headquarters, handling diverse projects with precision and efficiency.
Choose Lake County Outdoors, LLC for tailored solutions to meet all your commercial property needs.
items.imageAlt: Cedar pergola over a gravel fire pit area with Adirondack chairs

items.title: Our Commitment to Quality
paragraphs: At Lake County Outdoors, LLC, we deliver high-quality snow removal and landscaping services using top-tier materials and equipment. Our team stays current with the latest techniques and industry standards.

With a comprehensive fleet of 10 trucks, 14 Bobcats, 6 wheel loaders, and 2 tri-axle dump trucks with salters, we efficiently handle any snow removal challenge or land renovation project. Our dedicated team ensures reliability and constantly strives to deliver the best to our customers.
items.imageAlt: Plow trucks and skid steers with snow pushers parked in a lot during snowfall

items.title: Our Client Satisfaction
paragraphs: Creating a valuable experience and a beautiful finished product for our clients is what Lake County Outdoors values most. That's why we communicate efficiently, work to understand the needs of our customers, and deliver the best results.
We offer services to a diverse range of clients, including major retailers, and essential service providers like schools, public institutions, and residential homes.
Our commitment to excellence and professionalism ensures safe and accessible environments for customers and employees, all while getting the job done in the best and most efficient way.
